# Closures report (generated by `oyster-data closures`)

Growing areas: WQ. Sources: Maine DMR NSSP classification layer (2025) for standing closures; archived DMR notices for dated events (`sources/dmr_closure_events.py`).

| kind | closure type | rows | earliest start | history |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| standing | pollution | 8 | 2008-03-27 | classification since 2008, no end |
| event | pollution | 1 | 2021-06-25 | WQ:upper_river_oil_2021, 2021-06-25 to 2021-06-28 |
| event | biotoxin | 0 | | none naming these areas found in archived DMR notices 2009-2021; 2025 unknown |

Notes:

- WQ:CA1 conditionally approved (WWTP: Great Salt Bay WWTP); closure events not published, no rows
- WQ:upper_river_oil_2021: dam_lower (43.931 N) is well south of the closed reach. dam_upper (43.9996 N) lies at the southern boundary line (Perkins Point Rd, about 43.9999 N in OpenStreetMap), so whether it was inside is not resolved.
- Biotoxin: no American-oyster biotoxin closure naming the Damariscotta found 2009-2021; 2025 PSP closure coverage of the Damariscotta unknown. Settling 2017 and 2025 needs DMR records (FOAA request to DMRPublicHealthDiv@maine.gov).

Both Damariscotta model sites (dam_lower, dam_upper) lie in section WQ:A (Approved) in every NSSP layer 2015-2025 (point-in-polygon queries, 2026-10-13), so no standing closure applies to them.
